positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working on Cryptography!
Primarily working on the SymCrypt library (used for the majority of cryptography in Windows), to keep it secure, performant, FIPS certifiable, and cross platform.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on a project developing a new Azure service, helping to architect and implement the microservices required
Was a part of Azure Data Lake Storage team maintaining the key storage component of the service. Was in rotation to be on call to service immediate issues, and improved our team's ability to detect and respond to problems. Also was involved with feature work to enable a huge data migration (better securing exabytes of data at rest) and reduce the impact of customer errors (enabling a soft-delete feature)
Contributed to the isa-l project to improve CRC64 performance, and the SymCrypt project to improve AES performance
Moved to the Cryptography team full time

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description: Continuing work in various groups in ARM, primarily in System Architecture.

positions.title: Graduate Engineer
positions.description: Working in a variety of groups in ARM, including Systems Architecture benchmarking work, CPU Performance Modelling and GPU block level Formal verification.

positions.title: Datapath engineer (intern)
positions.description: RTL design, optimisation and formal verification of datapath components.

positions.title: C programmer (temporary role)
positions.description: I converted a new algorithm from MATLAB into C to create a bit perfect model of what the algorithm would do in hardware. I also added optimisation to enable much faster testing of the algorithm.
